natural: collude with a foreign country from inside

meaning.en: To collude with a foreign power against one's own country; treason.
meaning.zh: 暗中勾结外国势力，出卖本国利益。

examples.zh: 他被指控里通外国，出卖国家机密。
examples.en: He was accused of colluding with a foreign power and selling state secrets.

examples.zh: 历史上不少人因被诬里通外国而遭杀害。
examples.en: Many in history were killed after being falsely accused of treason.

usage.en: A grave political charge, often of a historic or legal kind. Verb phrase.
usage.zh: 严重的政治罪名，多见于历史和法律语境。

natural: first seduce, then abandon

meaning.en: To seduce and then abandon someone.
meaning.zh: 起初玩弄，最后抛弃，指对爱情不负责任。

examples.zh: 他对女友始乱终弃，遭到众人谴责。
examples.en: He seduced and abandoned his girlfriend and was widely condemned.

examples.zh: 小说批判了那种始乱终弃的负心汉。
examples.en: The novel criticises the faithless men who seduce and desert women.

story.en: In the Tang tale, after Zhang abandons Yingying, she writes: 'You began by toying with me and ended by casting me off; it is only fitting'.
story.zh: 元稹《莺莺传》中崔莺莺说：“始乱之，终弃之，固其宜矣，愚不敢恨。”

usage.en: Usually about a man's betrayal. 乱 here means 'to dally, to toy with'.
usage.zh: 多指男子负心。“乱”指玩弄。

natural: a tiger's back and a bear's waist

meaning.en: Broad-shouldered and sturdily built.
meaning.zh: 背宽腰粗，形容身体魁梧强壮。

examples.zh: 这位摔跤手虎背熊腰，一看就力气惊人。
examples.en: The wrestler is broad and burly and obviously very strong.

examples.zh: 他虽虎背熊腰，说话却轻声细语。
examples.en: Though built like an ox, he speaks softly.

usage.en: Describes men, sometimes women or athletes; usually admiring. Attributive or predicate.
usage.zh: 多形容男子或运动员，含赞美。

natural: a casual acquaintance

meaning.en: A superficial friendship; someone one knows only slightly.
meaning.zh: 交情不深的朋友。

examples.zh: 我和他只是泛泛之交，不了解他的为人。
examples.en: He and I are only slight acquaintances, so I do not know his character.

examples.zh: 职场中的泛泛之交很多，知心朋友却不多。
examples.en: There are many casual acquaintances at work but few close friends.

usage.en: Usually describes how well one knows someone. Not rude, but implies distance.
usage.zh: 说明交情浅，不算失礼，但表示关系疏远。

natural: her glances bring grace

meaning.en: Graceful and charming in every glance and turn.
meaning.zh: 回头张望之间神态生动，形容人风姿动人。

examples.zh: 她一出场便顾盼生姿，吸引了全场目光。
examples.en: The moment she stepped out she was captivating, drawing every eye.

examples.zh: 舞台上的主角顾盼生姿，令人难忘。
examples.en: The lead on stage was graceful in every glance, unforgettable.

usage.en: Usually describes a woman or a performer; elegant and admiring. 盼 is pàn.
usage.zh: 多形容女子或表演者，含赞美。

natural: tread danger as if on level ground

meaning.en: To face danger calmly as though nothing were wrong.
meaning.zh: 走在危险的地方如同走在平地上，比喻不怕危险，处变不惊。

examples.zh: 登山向导履险如夷，带队走过了雪脊。
examples.en: The mountain guide was unfazed by danger and led the party across the snow ridge.

examples.zh: 他在商场多年，对风险履险如夷。
examples.en: After years in business he takes risks in his stride.

usage.en: Praise for steady nerves. 夷 means 'level'. Often about climbing or about tough situations in life.
usage.zh: 赞扬沉着不怕险。“夷”是平坦。

natural: overturn the verdict and clear the name

meaning.en: To rehabilitate someone wrongly convicted or condemned.
meaning.zh: 纠正冤案错案，恢复名誉，洗清冤屈。

examples.zh: 经过重新调查，这起冤案终于平反昭雪。
examples.en: After fresh investigation, this wrongful case was finally overturned.

examples.zh: 他含冤二十年，直到今天才平反昭雪。
examples.en: He bore the injustice for twenty years and was only cleared today.

usage.en: A legal and political term; often with 冤案 or 含冤. 昭 means 'make clear'.
usage.zh: 法律、政治用语，常与冤案、含冤连用。

natural: restrain your grief and accept what has changed

meaning.en: Please restrain your grief (said to the bereaved).
meaning.zh: 请克制悲痛，顺应变故，是对丧亲者的安慰语。

examples.zh: 请节哀顺变，保重身体。
examples.en: Please bear up through your grief and take care of yourself.

examples.zh: 他握着朋友的手说：“节哀顺变。”
examples.en: He held his friend's hand and said, 'My deepest condolences.'

usage.en: A set condolence formula said to the bereaved. Never use it of yourself.
usage.zh: 对丧亲者的固定慰问语，不用于自己。

natural: the roc's journey of ten thousand li

meaning.en: A bright future ahead; used as a wish for a promising career.
meaning.zh: 大鹏展翅万里，比喻前程远大，常作祝愿。

examples.zh: 祝你毕业后鹏程万里！
examples.en: Wishing you a glorious career after graduation!

examples.zh: 他立志要在海外闯出一片天，鹏程万里。
examples.en: He is determined to make his mark overseas, with a splendid future ahead.

story.en: The Peng, when it travels to the southern darkness, beats the water for three thousand li and climbs a whirlwind ninety thousand li high.
story.zh: 《庄子》：“鹏之徙于南冥也，水击三千里，抟扶摇而上者九万里。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Common in graduation and farewell greetings. The Peng is the mythical giant bird of Zhuangzi.
usage.zh: 常用于毕业、送别祝福。鹏是《庄子》中的大鸟。

natural: walk leisurely in place of a carriage

meaning.en: To walk calmly instead of riding; to live simply and without rush.
meaning.zh: 慢慢步行当作乘车，也指生活简朴、不图享受。

examples.zh: 天气好，我们安步当车，走回家吧。
examples.en: The weather is fine; let us stroll home instead of riding.

examples.zh: 他退休后每天安步当车，悠然自得。
examples.en: After retirement he walks everywhere each day, quite at ease.

story.en: Yan Chu told King Xuan of Qi that he would rather 'eat late and call it meat, walk slowly and call it a carriage'.
story.zh: 颜斶说：“晚食以当肉，安步以当车，无罪以当贵，清静贞正以自虞。”

usage.en: Often a pleasant lifestyle choice or a modest way of making do. 当 means 'to take as'.
usage.zh: 可指悠闲步行，也指安贫知足。“当”是当作。

literal: not · live up to · everyone's · hopes
natural: fail to live up to expectations

meaning.en: To fall short of what the public expects.
meaning.zh: 没有达到大家的期望。

equivalents: fail to live up to expectations

examples.zh: 新任总经理不孚众望，业绩一落千丈。
examples.en: The new general manager fell short of expectations and results plunged.

examples.zh: 国足在比赛中不孚众望，球迷十分失望。
examples.en: The national football team fell short of hopes and fans were very disappointed.

usage.en: Opposite of 不负众望. Take care: 孚 means 'to earn the trust of'.
usage.zh: 与“不负众望”相对。“孚”意为使信服。

natural: each heads for their own future

meaning.en: To go separate ways, each pursuing a future of their own.
meaning.zh: 各自走向自己的前途，多指同学朋友分别。

equivalents: each strike out on one's own

examples.zh: 毕业之后，大家各奔前程。
examples.en: After graduation we all went our separate ways.

examples.zh: 合伙人最终各奔前程，没有再合作。
examples.en: The partners went their separate ways and never worked together again.

usage.en: Often warm, said at partings. 奔 is read bèn ('head for').
usage.zh: 多用于分别时，语气温和。“奔”读bèn。

synonyms: 夫妻本是同林鸟，大难临头各自飞

natural: wear armour and wield arms

meaning.en: To go into battle, fully armed.
meaning.zh: 穿上铠甲，拿起武器，指武装上阵。

equivalents: clad in armour and ready to fight

examples.zh: 将士披坚执锐，随时准备出战。
examples.en: The soldiers, in full armour, stood ready for battle.

examples.zh: 影片中，他披坚执锐，一骑当先。
examples.en: In the film he is armoured, spear in hand, leading the charge.

usage.en: Literary; here 坚 means 'armour' and 锐 'weapons'. Narrative style.
usage.zh: 书面语，“坚”指铠甲，“锐”指兵器。

natural: mountain light and water colours

meaning.en: Beautiful landscape scenery of hills and water.
meaning.zh: 山水的风光景色。

examples.zh: 游船缓缓前行，两岸山光水色尽收眼底。
examples.en: The boat glides along, taking in all the scenery of both banks.

examples.zh: 这里山光水色，令人流连忘返。
examples.en: The landscape here is so lovely that visitors linger.

usage.en: Used in travel writing and descriptions. Often attributive: 山光水色之美.
usage.zh: 多用于游记写景。

natural: people are not plants

meaning.en: Humans have feelings; one cannot be unmoved.
meaning.zh: 人不是草木，是有感情的，不会无动于衷。

examples.zh: 人非草木，孰能无情？他的付出我怎会不感动。
examples.en: We are not plants; how could I not be moved by what he gave?

examples.zh: 人非草木，被那样对待，谁能不伤心？
examples.en: Being human, who would not be hurt by such treatment?

usage.en: Usually followed by 孰能无情. Excuses or explains an emotional response.
usage.zh: 常接“孰能无情”，用来解释自己动了感情。

literal: not · know · all together · how many
natural: no one knows how many

meaning.en: Countless; beyond counting.
meaning.zh: 不知道一共有多少，形容数量很多。

examples.zh: 像他这样的人才，在我们国家不知凡几。
examples.en: People with talent like his are countless in our country.

examples.zh: 这座古城里留下的传说不知凡几。
examples.en: This old city has countless legends.

usage.en: Formal; note 凡几 = 'how many', not 'ordinary'. Predicate.
usage.zh: 书面语。“凡几”是一共多少。

natural: scattered like wind and clouds

meaning.en: Friends or things dispersed and gone.
meaning.zh: 像风吹云散一样，比喻亲友离散、事物消失。

examples.zh: 毕业十年，同学们风流云散，难得聚首。
examples.en: A decade after graduation our classmates are scattered; rarely do we meet.

examples.zh: 昔日的繁华，如今已风流云散。
examples.en: The glory of old has now vanished like wind and cloud.

story.en: Wang Can wrote to his friend: 'Like wind blown and clouds scattered, parting is as rain'.
story.zh: 王粲《赠蔡子笃诗》：“风流云散，一别如雨。”

usage.en: Sad, nostalgic tone. In some contexts 风流 means 'heroes of the age', but here it describes dispersal.
usage.zh: 带伤感怀旧的语气。

natural: clear, splendid waters and woods

meaning.en: Fresh and lovely scenery of water and trees; also the name of a Tsinghua campus spot.
meaning.zh: 水边林木清秀美丽，也是清华园的别称。

examples.zh: 园子里水木清华，是读书的好地方。
examples.en: The garden, with its clear waters and trees, is a fine place to study.

examples.zh: 清华园的“水木清华”景色宜人。
examples.en: The Tsinghua campus's 'Shuimu Qinghua' is delightful scenery.

story.en: The Jin poet Xie Hun wrote: 'Water and trees are filled with clear splendour' (水木湛清华).
story.zh: 谢混《游西池》：“景昃鸣禽集，水木湛清华。”

usage.en: Poetic. In modern China 水木清华 is closely associated with Tsinghua University.
usage.zh: 带诗意。现代常与清华大学联系。

natural: win first place in all three exams in a row

meaning.en: To top all three levels of the imperial exams; now, to win three successive top honours.
meaning.zh: 旧指在乡试、会试、殿试中连续考得第一，今泛指接连三次夺魁。

equivalents: a grand slam of first places

examples.zh: 他连中三元，成为科举史上的佳话。
examples.en: He topped all three exams in a row, a famous tale in the history of the imperial examinations.

examples.zh: 这位运动员连中三元，包揽三项冠军。
examples.en: The athlete won three titles in a row, sweeping all the events.

usage.en: 中 is read zhòng ('hit, win'). The three firsts are 解元, 会元, 状元. Also 连中三元 for modern contests.
usage.zh: “中”读zhòng。三元指解元、会元、状元。

natural: smile in the Nine Springs

meaning.en: To rest content in the afterlife, knowing one's wishes were fulfilled.
meaning.zh: 在九泉之下也感到欣慰，指死而无憾。

examples.zh: 看到孩子们事业有成，老人可以含笑九泉了。
examples.en: Seeing his children succeed, the old man can rest happy in the grave.

examples.zh: 如果烈士知道今天的盛世，一定含笑九泉。
examples.en: Could the martyrs see today's prosperity, they would smile in the afterlife.

usage.en: Used of the dead, in tributes or consolation. “九泉” means the underworld.
usage.zh: 多用于悼念或安慰，“九泉”指阴间。

natural: a human face with a beast's heart

meaning.en: A person who looks human but is cruel and wicked inside.
meaning.zh: 长着人的面孔却有野兽的心肠，形容凶狠残忍、品行恶劣。

examples.zh: 这个骗子专骗老人，简直人面兽心。
examples.en: This swindler preys on old people and is a monster in human form.

examples.zh: 别被他和善的外表骗了，他其实人面兽心。
examples.en: Do not be fooled by his friendly looks; he is actually vicious.

story.en: Ban Gu says of the Xiongnu that, with their loose hair and left-folding robes, they have 'human faces and beasts' hearts'.
story.zh: 《汉书·匈奴传赞》：“夫匈奴……被发左衽，人面兽心。”

usage.en: A strong insult; compare 衣冠禽兽, which stresses fine clothes and a respectable front.
usage.zh: 骂人话，语气重。与“衣冠禽兽”相比，后者强调外表体面。

natural: you need not open your honoured mouth

meaning.en: There is no need to say any more (politely or sarcastically).
meaning.zh: 不必开口，请不要多说，常含客气或讽刺。

equivalents: no need to say another word

examples.zh: 你要是来说情的，就免开尊口。
examples.en: If you came to plead for him, you may save your breath.

examples.zh: 这件事我自有主张，诸位请免开尊口。
examples.en: I have my own mind on this matter; gentlemen, kindly say no more.

usage.en: Ironic politeness: 尊口 is an honorific. Often a firm brush-off, as in the old-style novels.
usage.zh: 用敬辞表示婉拒，常带讽刺，多见旧小说。

natural: nostrils pointing to the sky

meaning.en: Looking arrogant, with one's nose in the air.
meaning.zh: 鼻子朝上，形容傲慢、看不起人的样子。

equivalents: with one's nose in the air

examples.zh: 他当了经理以后，走路都鼻孔朝天。
examples.en: Since becoming manager he walks with his nose in the air.

examples.zh: 别看他一副鼻孔朝天的样子，其实内心很自卑。
examples.en: Despite his snooty look, he is actually insecure.

usage.en: Colloquial. 朝 is cháo ('face'), not zhāo.
usage.zh: 口语。“朝”读cháo，意为朝向。

natural: carrying spears and clubs in one's words

meaning.en: To speak with barbs hidden in the words.
meaning.zh: 说话中暗含讥讽、攻击。

examples.zh: 他讲话夹枪带棒，同事们都不愿和他交谈。
examples.en: His words are full of barbs and colleagues avoid talking to him.

examples.zh: 她那番夹枪带棒的话，明显是冲着我来的。
examples.en: Those barbed remarks of hers were clearly aimed at me.

usage.en: Colloquial; refers to speech that stings. Often combined with 阴阳怪气.
usage.zh: 口语，指话里带刺，常与“阴阳怪气”并用。

natural: a huge wound and deep pain

meaning.en: Having suffered a heavy blow and deep pain.
meaning.zh: 伤口大，痛苦深，比喻遭受的损失和创伤很重。

examples.zh: 这场金融危机让许多家庭创巨痛深。
examples.en: The financial crisis left many families grievously hurt.

examples.zh: 战争带来的创巨痛深，让人们格外珍惜和平。
examples.en: The deep wounds the war caused made people value peace all the more.

usage.en: Formal and sombre. 创 is chuāng ('wound'), not chuàng.
usage.zh: 庄重沉痛。“创”读chuāng，意为伤口。
